Pubkey seed and program-address derivation helpers with custom error codes.

# Purpose
This header declares public key utility functions for the Flamenco runtime. It defines seed size limits and custom error codes used by pubkey derivation logic. The file also declares [`fd_pubkey_create_with_seed`](<#fd_pubkey_create_with_seed>), [`fd_pubkey_derive_pda`](<#fd_pubkey_derive_pda>), and [`fd_pubkey_find_program_address`](<#fd_pubkey_find_program_address>), which create derived public keys and program derived addresses from a base key, seed data, and a program ID. These functions use execution context types from the instruction and transaction context headers and return status values plus optional error details and bump seeds.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_pubkey_create_with_seed`
- `fd_pubkey_derive_pda`
- `fd_pubkey_find_program_address`
